issue.title: sase agent-state tests (dismiss reconcile after root delete, marker-only population parity) fail intermittently in the full suite

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by bob-cli-jf.1.2 (note #3) while verifying the SASE checkout-identity guard; triaged by the bob-cli-jf.1 lander. These are failures in the sase repository's test suite (open it with `sase repo open sase`).

- FAIL: required-check ToolRun 1ff97e7d77df29ca1443b8d36fbfb1d8, a full sase suite on the guard tree (16510 passed, 8 failed, 8 skipped). It failed:
  - tests/test_agent_dismiss_persistence.py::test_normal_dismiss_reconciles_unloaded_agent_session_members_after_root_delete (two dismissed timestamps remained visible)
  - tests/test_agent_loader_agents_list_projection.py::test_production_paths_keep_parity_with_marker_only_population (49 missing production rows)
- PASS: both tests passed when rerun on the same tree with production code unchanged. Both also passed on clean base bd97664e07f78922f4f9803cb5688ba0b425f6fd in an isolated worktree, using the same core 0.44.2 wheel (SASE_CORE_WHEEL).
- Neither test touches the guard change (a14bffcdbf), so the failure is not caused by bob-cli-jf.1.
- Fail rate: 1 failure in 2 observed runs each. Seen only in the full parallel suite; isolated reruns pass. Suspect suite-order or shared agent-state sensitivity. ToolRun triage identified no owner.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: sase repo: full required check (ToolRun 1ff97e7d77df29ca1443b8d36fbfb1d8) with SASE_CORE_WHEEL=core 0.44.2

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-jf.1.2 guard verification hit two sase agent-state tests that failed in the full suite and passed on rerun and on the clean base; nothing tracks them yet.
